All 4 tests pass. Here's the summary:

Change made (wrap-index.mjs):

// Before
return index % length;

// After
return ((index % length) + length) % length;

Copy code

Why it works: JavaScript's % operator returns a negative result when the dividend is negative (e.g., -1 % 5 === -1). Adding length before the second % length shifts any negative remainder into the positive range, then the outer modulo keeps values already in [0, length) unchanged.
